title: Phase status
description: State of a phase or work package in docs/pipeline-status/<name>/<phase-id>.yaml. A phase is done when this file exists on baseBranch with status done. On the phase branch the same file holds the checkpoint of an unfinished phase (status in-progress) until delivery replaces it.

status.description: done: delivered. in-progress: checkpoint on the phase branch, written after every build and review step.

step.description: in-progress only: the last finished step of the round. build: the review of this round is next. review: evaluating the findings is next.

findings.description: in-progress only, after a review step: the open findings, so the next round can start without the reviewers.

question.description: in-progress only: a question waiting for the user, in one line.

consults.description: Number of consult questions per answering party, e.g. { "controller": 2, "human": 1, "orchestrator": 1 }.
